columns.name: tagline
columns.label: Tagline
columns.help: One short line shown at the top of every page, e.g. Fresh flowers delivered across Dubai.

columns.name: phone
columns.label: Phone for customers
columns.help: International format, e.g. +971501234567. Customers can call it from the tracking page.

columns.name: logo
columns.label: Logo
columns.help: Optional. A wide logo on a transparent or white background; it replaces the shop name in the header and on invoices.

columns.name: hero_image
columns.label: Banner photo
columns.help: Optional. A photo for the page where customers enter their tracking code, e.g. your shop or a bouquet. modern, classic, rounded: shown next to the form. heritage, atelier: fills the screen above it (wide, 2000 px).

columns.name: story
columns.label: Story
columns.help: Optional. One or two sentences about your shop, shown under the tracking form, e.g. what you deliver and where.

columns.name: story_image
columns.label: Story photo
columns.help: Optional. With the heritage and atelier fonts: a photo near the end of the tracking home page, next to your address and phone number. Portrait photos work best.

columns.name: brand_color
columns.label: Brand colour
columns.help: Your main colour as a hex code, e.g. #8A2D4B for deep rose, #1F4D3A for palm green, or #1F1B17 (deep ink) and #000000 (black) with the heritage and atelier fonts. Buttons, the map pin and highlights use it; text on it turns white or dark by itself.

columns.name: font
columns.label: Font
columns.help: modern: clean. classic: serif headings, for flowers and gifts. rounded: friendly. heritage: Arabian luxury, ivory and gold. atelier: modern luxury in black and white. heritage and atelier use the luxury layout (centred name, full-width photo). All have Arabic. boutique: warm, arched photos.

columns.name: lat
columns.label: Shop latitude
columns.help: Optional. Where your shop is, e.g. 25.2292; with the longitude the tracking map shows a flower pin there. Copy both from Google Maps (right-click the shop).

columns.name: code
columns.label: Tracking code
columns.help: Give the customer this code or the link /track/<#>?code=<code>.

columns.name: courier_key
columns.label: Courier key
columns.help: A long secret. Send the courier the link /courier/<#>?key=<key>; anyone with it can move the delivery on the map.

columns.name: items
columns.label: What is delivered
columns.help: Shown to the customer, e.g. Blush peony bouquet.

columns.name: delivery_window
columns.label: Delivery window
columns.help: Shown to the customer, e.g. Today, 14:00-16:00.

columns.name: dest_lat
columns.label: Drop-off latitude
columns.help: Optional. Where the delivery goes; the map shows a pin there.

columns.name: route
columns.label: Sample route
columns.help: Optional, for samples: the points the simulated courier drives, as [[lat, lng], [lat, lng], ...]. Without it the simulation goes straight from the shop to the drop-off.

columns.name: sample
columns.label: Sample
columns.help: Samples are listed on the home page so visitors can open the tracking page and watch a simulated courier. Turn this off or delete the samples before you take real orders; real deliveries are never listed.

shop.name: Al Noor Flowers
shop.tagline: Fresh flowers delivered across Dubai, the same day
shop.tagline_ar: زهور طازجة نوصلها في أنحاء دبي في اليوم نفسه
shop.address: Shop 4, Jumeirah Beach Road, Jumeirah 1, Dubai
shop.story: We tie every bouquet by hand in our Jumeirah studio and deliver it the same day.
shop.story_ar: نربط كل باقة بأيدينا في مشغلنا في جميرا ونوصلها في اليوم نفسه.

deliveries.items: 24 red roses in a hat box
White orchid in a ceramic pot

texts.en: Enter the order number and tracking code from your message.
texts.ar: أدخل رقم الطلب ورمز التتبع الواردين في رسالتك.

texts.en: As written in your message, e.g. ABC123
texts.ar: كما ورد في رسالتك، مثل ABC123

texts.en: Keep this page open with the screen on while you drive.
texts.ar: أبقِ هذه الصفحة مفتوحة والشاشة مضاءة أثناء القيادة.

texts.en: Could not send ({code}). Trying again with the next position.
texts.ar: تعذّر الإرسال ({code}). ستُعاد المحاولة مع الموقع التالي.

texts.en: This phone cannot share its location.
texts.ar: لا يستطيع هذا الهاتف مشاركة موقعه.

texts.en: Thank you. The customer has been told.
We could not find that delivery
Check the order number and tracking code in your message, or ask the shop for a new link.
texts.ar: تحقّق من رقم الطلب ورمز التتبع في رسالتك، أو اطلب من المتجر رابطًا جديدًا.

texts.en: These are sample orders. Open one to see the page your customers get, then watch a simulated courier drive it to the door.
texts.ar: هذه طلبات تجريبية. افتح أحدها لترى الصفحة التي تصل إلى عملائك، ثم شاهد مندوباً افتراضياً يوصلها حتى الباب.

texts.en: A sample delivery: press Simulate to watch the courier's drive. Nothing is saved.
texts.ar: توصيلة تجريبية: اضغط على المحاكاة لتشاهد رحلة المندوب. لا يُحفظ شيء.

texts.en: Simulated courier, live on the map
We tie your flowers by hand and wrap them with a card.
texts.ar: نربط زهورك بأيدينا ونغلفها مع بطاقة.

texts.en: A courier picks them up and you follow the ride on the map.
texts.ar: يستلمها المندوب وتتابع الرحلة على الخريطة.

texts.en: You see the moment they reach the door.

templates.css:
<style>
[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Renoxium template design system: shared base. The theme (brand colour, font, logo) comes from theme() in lib and sits on <html>. */
:root{color-scheme:light;--brand:#334155;--on-brand:#fff;--brand-text:#334155;
--paper:#fff;--ink:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 14%,#121212);--ink-2:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 74%,#fff);
--line:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 12%,#fff);--line-strong:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 28%,#fff);
--well:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 5%,#f4f3f1);--brand-soft:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 8%,#fff);
--brand-hover:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 84%,#000);--danger:#a3261d;--danger-soft:#fbeeec;
--r-control:8px;--r-media:4px;--r-sheet:12px;
--fs-14:.875rem;--fs-16:1rem;--fs-18:1.125rem;--fs-22:1.375rem;--fs-28:1.75rem;--fs-36:2.25rem;--fs-48:3rem;
--font-text:"IBM Plex Sans","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;--font-display:var(--font-text);--display-boost:1}
[data-font=classic]{--font-display:"Markazi Text","Noto Naskh Arabic",Georgia,serif;--display-boost:1.16}
[data-font=rounded]{--font-text:"Rubik",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif}
/* Luxury type pairs (font = heritage or atelier; theme() then sets data-style=luxury). Arabic falls through to the Arabic face. */
[data-font=heritage]{--paper:#fbf8f2;--well:#f0eadf;--accent:#a08048;--font-display:"Cormorant Garamond","Amiri",Georgia,serif;--font-text:"Jost","Noto Naskh Arabic",system-ui,sans-serif}
[data-font=atelier]{--paper:#fff;--well:#f3f2ef;--accent:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 40%,#fff);--font-display:"Bodoni Moda","Noto Naskh Arabic",Didot,Georgia,serif;--font-text:"Hanken Grotesk","Noto Kufi Arabic",system-ui,sans-serif}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-text);font-size:var(--fs-16);line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-wrap:break-word}
body:lang(ar){line-height:1.75}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
h1,h2{font-family:var(--font-display)}
h1{font-size:calc(var(--fs-28) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.015em}
h2{font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h3{font-size:var(--fs-18);line-height:1.35}
h1:lang(ar),h2:lang(ar),h3:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.45}
@media(min-width:720px){h1{font-size:calc(var(--fs-36) * var(--display-boost))}}
p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:.22em}
a:hover{color:var(--brand-text)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-text);outline-offset:2px}
.num,.price{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums}
.price{white-space:nowrap}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.small{font-size:var(--fs-14)}.quiet{color:var(--ink-2)}
.wrap{--gutter:16px;max-width:1180px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
@media(min-width:720px){.wrap{--gutter:24px}}
@media(min-width:1080px){.wrap{--gutter:32px}}
.skip{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-9999px;top:8px}.skip:focus{inset-inline-start:16px;z-index:50;background:var(--paper);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-control)}

/* Top bar, header, footer */
.bar{background:var(--well);font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.bar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 16px;min-height:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.langs{display:flex;align-items:center}
.langs a{text-decoration:none;padding:6px 0;color:var(--ink-2)}
.langs a+a{margin-inline-start:12px;padding-inline-start:12px;border-inline-start:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.langs a[aria-current]{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.site-head .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:64px}
.mark{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.2;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.mark img{max-height:40px;width:auto}
.acts{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;font-size:var(--fs-16)}
.acts a{text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:44px}
.acts a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.count{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:22px;height:22px;padding-inline:6px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1}
.count[hidden]{display:none}
.site-foot{margin-top:72px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.site-foot .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px 40px;padding-block:32px 40px}
.site-foot strong{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;font-size:var(--fs-16)}
.foot-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 24px}
.foot-links form{margin:0}

/* Page heads, buttons, notices */
.page-head{padding-block:32px 24px}
.page-head p{margin-top:8px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:var(--r-control);border:1px solid transparent;font:inherit;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--brand-hover);color:var(--on-brand)}
.btn.line{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.btn.line:hover{border-color:var(--ink);background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.wide{width:100%}
.linkbtn{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:.22em;cursor:pointer}
.linkbtn:hover{color:var(--brand-text)}
.alert{background:var(--danger-soft);color:var(--danger);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-control);margin-bottom:24px}
.notice{background:var(--brand-soft);padding:20px;border-radius:var(--r-sheet);margin-bottom:8px}
.notice p+p{margin-top:4px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.empty{padding-block:48px 24px;max-width:34em}
.empty p{margin:8px 0 24px;color:var(--ink-2)}

/* Forms: labels above fields, grouped in sections */
.group{border:0;padding:0;margin:0 0 32px;min-width:0}
.group>legend{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.3;padding:0;margin-bottom:16px}
.field{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px}
.field>label,.lab{font-size:var(--fs-14);font-weight:500}
.hint{font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-control);min-height:48px;padding:11px 14px;width:100%}
textarea{min-height:88px;resize:vertical}
[dir=rtl] input[dir=ltr]{text-align:right}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--brand-text);outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand-text) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:0}
input[type=radio],input[type=checkbox]{width:20px;height:20px;min-height:0;margin:0;accent-color:var(--brand-text);flex:none}
@media(min-width:720px){.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 16px}}
.choice{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-control);margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer}
.choice input{margin-top:3px}
.choice:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--brand-text);background:var(--brand-soft)}
.choice .hint{display:block}

/* Totals and key-value lists */
.rows{display:grid}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;padding-block:6px}
.row>:last-child{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;text-align:end;white-space:nowrap}
.row.total{border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong);margin-top:8px;padding-top:14px;font-weight:600;font-size:var(--fs-18)}
.row.sub{font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2);padding-top:0}
.facts{margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.facts>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(6.5em,30%) 1fr;gap:4px 16px;padding-block:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.facts dt{font-weight:500}.facts dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink-2)}
.facts dd span{display:block}
.sheet{background:var(--well);border-radius:var(--r-sheet);padding:20px}
.sheet h2{font-size:var(--fs-18);font-family:var(--font-text);letter-spacing:0;margin-bottom:12px}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
@media print{.bar,.site-head,.site-foot,.noprint,.buybar,.skip{display:none!important}body{font-size:11pt}a{text-decoration:none}.sheet{background:none;padding:0}}

/* Luxury style (data-style=luxury): paper instead of white, no radii, hairlines only, light display type, small tracked labels in Latin. */
[data-style=luxury]{--ink-2:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 68%,var(--paper));--line:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 11%,var(--paper));--line-strong:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 30%,var(--paper));
--brand-soft:var(--well);--r-control:0;--r-media:0;--r-sheet:0;--label:.75rem;--label-ar:.9375rem}
[data-style=luxury] body{line-height:1.65}
[data-style=luxury] main>.wrap{padding-bottom:120px}
[data-style=luxury] :is(h1,h2,.tname,.line-name,.o-id,.mark){font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
[data-style=luxury] .wrap{max-width:1360px}
[data-style=luxury] body:lang(ar){font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.9}
[data-style=luxury] h1,[data-style=luxury] h2,[data-style=luxury] .group>legend{font-weight:300;letter-spacing:0}
[data-style=luxury] h1{font-size:2.25rem;line-height:1.1}
[data-style=luxury] h2{font-size:1.75rem;line-height:1.2}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] h1{font-size:2.875rem}}
[data-style=luxury] h1:lang(ar){font-size:2rem;line-height:1.6}[data-style=luxury] h2:lang(ar){font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.6}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] h1:lang(ar){font-size:2.375rem}}
[data-font=heritage] h1:lang(ar),[data-font=heritage] h2:lang(ar),[data-font=heritage] .group>legend:lang(ar){font-weight:400}
[data-font=atelier] h1,[data-font=atelier] h2,[data-font=atelier] .group>legend{font-weight:400}
[data-font=atelier] h1{letter-spacing:-.01em}
/* Labels: navigation, buttons, legends. Latin small and tracked in capitals; Arabic never. */
[data-style=luxury] :is(.bar,.langs,.acts,.btn,.cta,.cats,.lab,.field>label,.opts legend,.facts dt,.foot-links,.meta dt){font-size:var(--label);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:400}
[data-style=luxury] :is(.btn,.cta,.lab,.field>label,.opts legend,.facts dt){font-weight:500}
[data-style=luxury]:lang(ar) :is(.bar,.langs,.acts,.btn,.cta,.cats,.lab,.field>label,.opts legend,.facts dt,.foot-links,.meta dt){font-size:var(--label-ar);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
[data-style=luxury] .langs a:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;font-size:var(--label-ar);text-transform:none}
[data-style=luxury] .langs a:lang(en){letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:var(--label);text-transform:uppercase}
[data-style=luxury] .bar{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink-2)}
[data-style=luxury] .bar .wrap{justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding-top:6px;text-align:center}
[data-style=luxury] .site-head{background:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
[data-style=luxury] .site-head .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:12px;min-height:64px}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] .site-head .wrap{min-height:84px}}
[data-style=luxury] .site-head .langs{justify-self:start}
[data-style=luxury] .site-head .acts{justify-self:end;gap:28px}
[data-style=luxury] .langs a+a{border:0;padding-inline-start:0;margin-inline-start:20px}
[data-style=luxury] .langs a[aria-current]{color:var(--ink);font-weight:400;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:.5em}
@media(max-width:719px){[data-style=luxury] .langs a[aria-current]{display:none}[data-style=luxury] .langs a+a{margin:0}[data-style=luxury] .acts .acct{display:none}}
[data-style=luxury] .mark{font-weight:400;font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center;line-height:1.1;white-space:nowrap}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] .mark{font-size:1.625rem;letter-spacing:.24em}}
[data-style=luxury] .mark:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;font-size:1.625rem;line-height:1.4}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] .mark:lang(ar){font-size:2.125rem}}
[data-font=heritage] .mark:lang(ar){font-family:"Amiri",serif}
[data-font=atelier] .mark{font-family:var(--font-text);font-weight:500;font-size:.875rem;letter-spacing:.4em}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-font=atelier] .mark{font-size:1rem}}
[data-font=atelier] .mark:lang(ar){font-size:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:500}
[data-style=luxury] .acts a{gap:0}
[data-style=luxury] .count{display:inline;min-width:0;height:auto;padding:0;border-radius:0;background:none;color:inherit;font-size:inherit;font-weight:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit}
[data-style=luxury] .count{margin-inline-start:.45em}[data-style=luxury] .count::before{content:"("}[data-style=luxury] .count::after{content:")"}
[data-style=luxury] .count[hidden]{display:none}
[data-style=luxury] .site-foot{margin-top:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);text-align:center}
[data-style=luxury] .site-foot .wrap{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding-block:72px 64px}
[data-style=luxury] .site-foot strong{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:1.375rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
[data-style=luxury] .site-foot strong:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;font-size:1.5rem}
[data-font=atelier] .site-foot strong{font-family:var(--font-text);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.4em}
[data-style=luxury] .foot-links{justify-content:center;gap:12px 32px}
[data-style=luxury] .foot-links a,[data-style=luxury] .foot-links .linkbtn{text-decoration:none}
[data-style=luxury] .foot-links .linkbtn{letter-spacing:inherit;text-transform:inherit}
[data-style=luxury] .page-head{padding-block:48px 32px}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] .page-head{padding-block:72px 40px}}
[data-style=luxury] .btn{min-height:52px;padding:14px 32px;background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand)}
[data-style=luxury] .btn:hover{background:var(--brand-hover);border-color:var(--brand-hover)}
[data-style=luxury] .btn.line{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
[data-style=luxury] .btn.line:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
[data-style=luxury] .cta{display:inline-block;padding-block:10px 6px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent)}
[data-style=luxury] .cta:hover{color:inherit;border-bottom-color:currentColor}
[data-style=luxury] .notice{background:var(--well)}
[data-style=luxury] .empty{padding-block:72px 120px}
[data-style=luxury] .group>legend{font-size:1.625rem;margin-bottom:20px}
[data-style=luxury] .group>legend:lang(ar){font-size:1.375rem}
[data-style=luxury] input,[data-style=luxury] select,[data-style=luxury] textarea{background:transparent;border-color:var(--line-strong)}
[data-style=luxury] input:focus,[data-style=luxury] select:focus,[data-style=luxury] textarea:focus{border-color:var(--ink);outline:1px solid var(--ink)}
[data-style=luxury] input[type=radio],[data-style=luxury] input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:var(--ink)}
[data-style=luxury] .choice{border-color:var(--line)}

templates.boutique:
<style>
/* Boutique (font = boutique): warm cream paper, deep brown ink, the brand colour (terracotta by default) as the accent,
   an elegant display serif (Gilda Display; Amiri in Arabic) with a light sans (DM Sans; IBM Plex Sans Arabic), softly
   rounded photos and small tracked labels. theme() keeps the standard layout; templates add their own boutique
   sections under [data-font=boutique]. The same copy is in every template. */
[data-font=boutique]{--paper:#fbf6f1;--well:#f2e6dc;--ink:#3b2a22;--ink-2:#6e5a4f;--line:#eadcd0;--line-strong:#d7c2b2;
--brand-soft:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 10%,#fbf6f1);--brand-hover:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 86%,#000);--accent:var(--brand);
--r-control:4px;--r-media:16px;--r-sheet:20px;--display-boost:1.06;
--font-display:"Gilda Display","Amiri",Georgia,serif;--font-text:"DM Sans","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
[data-font=boutique] body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}
[data-font=boutique] h1,[data-font=boutique] h2,[data-font=boutique] h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
[data-font=boutique] .btn,[data-font=boutique] .cta{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500}
[data-font=boutique] .tile .well{border-radius:var(--r-media)}
[data-font=boutique] .site-foot{background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand);border:0}
[data-font=boutique] .site-foot a,[data-font=boutique] .site-foot .linkbtn{color:inherit}
.eyebrow{display:block;font:500 .72rem/1.4 var(--font-text);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brand-text);margin:0 0 14px}
.rule{display:block;width:44px;height:1px;background:var(--brand);margin:0 0 22px}
.arch{border-radius:999px 999px var(--r-media) var(--r-media);overflow:hidden}.oval{border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
.arr{display:inline-block;margin-inline-start:.55em;transition:transform .18s ease}
a:hover>.arr{transform:translateX(3px)}[dir=rtl] .arr{transform:scaleX(-1)}[dir=rtl] a:hover>.arr{transform:scaleX(-1) translateX(3px)}
</style>

templates.florist:
<style>
/* Florist look of the delivery template: sample delivery cards, the tracking page (map with the shop, the drop-off
   and the route; a vertical progress list; the simulated courier) and, with the boutique font, a blush palette with
   rose serif headings, framed photos and eucalyptus sprigs. Every colour follows the shop's brand colour. */
html[data-font=boutique]{--paper:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 4%,#fffafa);--well:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 9%,#fdf6f6);
--band:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 11%,#fdf5f5);--ink:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 22%,#2b1a20);--ink-2:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 30%,#6f5b62);
--line:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 16%,#f6ecec);--line-strong:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 30%,#ecdcdc);--sage:#7f9c86;--sage-2:#a9c0ae}
html[data-font=boutique] body{background:var(--paper)}
html[data-font=boutique] :is(h1,h2){color:var(--brand-text)}
html[data-font=boutique] .bar{background:var(--band);color:var(--ink-2)}
html[data-font=boutique] .site-head{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--paper) 92%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
html[data-font=boutique] .mark{color:var(--brand-text);letter-spacing:.02em}
html[data-font=boutique] .acts a,html[data-font=boutique] .langs a{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none}
html[data-font=boutique] .langs a:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-size:.9rem}
html[data-font=boutique] .btn.line{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand-text)}
html[data-font=boutique] .btn.line:hover{background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand)}
/* The home hero: blush instead of a brand-coloured band, the photo in a white frame over a soft circle. */
html[data-font=boutique] .intro{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
html[data-font=boutique] .intro h1{color:var(--brand-text);font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.2rem);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.01em}
html[data-font=boutique] .intro h1:lang(ar){line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:0}
html[data-font=boutique] .intro-text p{color:var(--ink-2);opacity:1}
html[data-font=boutique] .track-form{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 18px 40px -26px color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 55%,transparent)}
html[data-font=boutique] .track-intro.has-photo .wrap{align-items:center}
html[data-font=boutique] .intro-photo{position:relative;margin:24px 0 40px;align-self:center}
html[data-font=boutique] .intro-photo::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-6% -8% auto auto;width:78%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:var(--band);z-index:-1}
html[data-font=boutique] .intro-photo img,html[data-font=boutique] .shop-story img{border:10px solid #fff;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 22px 44px -24px rgb(60 20 35/.45)}
html[data-font=boutique] .track-intro .intro-photo img{min-height:0;max-height:520px;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover}
@media(min-width:900px){html[data-font=boutique] .intro-photo{margin:56px 0;transform:rotate(1.2deg)}html[data-font=boutique] .track-intro.has-photo .intro-main{padding-block:72px}}
html[data-font=boutique] .shop-story p{color:var(--brand-text)}
.band{background:var(--band,var(--well))}
/* Eucalyptus sprigs: decoration only. */
.sprig{position:absolute;width:120px;height:auto;pointer-events:none;opacity:.9;display:none}
.sprig .s-stem{fill:none;stroke:var(--sage,#7f9c86);stroke-width:2.5;stroke-linecap:round}
.sprig .s-leaves{fill:var(--sage-2,#a9c0ae)}.sprig .s-leaves ellipse:nth-child(odd){fill:var(--sage,#7f9c86)}
html[data-font=boutique] .sprig{display:block}
@media(max-width:899px){html[data-font=boutique] .sprig{display:none}}
.sprig-a{inset-inline-start:-34px;top:-40px;transform:rotate(-24deg)}
.sprig-b{inset-inline-end:-30px;bottom:-60px;transform:rotate(160deg)}
/* Sample deliveries on the home page. */
.fl-samples{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-block:56px 64px;margin-top:40px}
.fl-head{max-width:40em;margin-bottom:28px}.fl-head h2{margin-bottom:10px}.fl-head p{color:var(--ink-2)}
.fl-cards{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:18px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr))}
.fl-card{display:grid;gap:6px;height:100%;padding:14px 14px 18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-media,6px);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);
 transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.fl-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px -24px color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 60%,transparent);color:var(--ink)}
.fl-art{display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:calc(var(--r-media,6px) - 2px);background:var(--well);margin-bottom:6px;overflow:hidden}
.fl-art svg{width:58%;height:auto}
.fl-art .petals{fill:var(--p1)}.fl-art .inner{fill:var(--p2)}.fl-art .core{fill:var(--p3)}
.fl-art .leaf{fill:var(--sage-2,#a9c0ae)}.fl-art .stem{fill:none;stroke:var(--sage,#7f9c86);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round}
.tone-1{--p1:#f4b6c6;--p2:#ec8fa8;--p3:#c2466c;background:#fbe9ee}
.tone-2{--p1:#d84a63;--p2:#b02a48;--p3:#7d1a33;background:#f9e3e6}
.tone-3{--p1:#fbf7f4;--p2:#efe6df;--p3:#d9b25e;background:#f3eee9}
.tone-4{--p1:#f7c9a9;--p2:#f1a982;--p3:#c56b44;background:#fcece2}
.tone-5{--p1:#d9c3ec;--p2:#bb9bdc;--p3:#7f5aa8;background:#f1e9f8}
.fl-pill{justify-self:start;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--well);color:var(--ink-2)}
.fl-pill.st-on_the_way{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 14%,#fff);color:var(--brand-text)}
.fl-pill.st-delivered{background:#e5f1e8;color:#2f6b45}
.fl-item{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--brand-text)}
.fl-meta,.fl-when{font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.fl-go{margin-top:8px;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;color:var(--brand-text)}
.fl-go:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-size:.9rem}
.fl-card:hover .arr{transform:translateX(3px)}[dir=rtl] .fl-go .arr{transform:scaleX(-1)}
/* How delivery works. */
.fl-how{padding-block:56px 24px}.fl-how h2{margin-bottom:24px}
.fl-how ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:24px}
@media(min-width:760px){.fl-how ol{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:40px}}
.fl-how li{display:grid;gap:8px;align-content:start}
.fl-num{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--brand);color:var(--brand-text);font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem}
.fl-how p{color:var(--ink-2)}
/* The tracking page. */
.fl-track{padding-bottom:56px}
.fl-track .track-head h1{margin-bottom:6px}
.fl-grid{display:grid;gap:24px}
@media(min-width:900px){.fl-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 340px;column-gap:44px;align-items:start}.fl-side{position:sticky;top:96px}}
.fl-mapcol{display:grid;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.fl-track .map-box{margin-inline:0;border-radius:var(--r-media,6px);overflow:hidden;border:10px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 22px 44px -28px rgb(60 20 35/.45)}
.fl-track #map{height:min(62svh,560px);min-height:320px;border-radius:0}
.fl-meter{display:grid;gap:8px}
.fl-meter-bar{height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.fl-meter-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--brand);border-radius:inherit}
.fl-meter p{font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.fl-side{display:grid;gap:20px;align-content:start}
.fl-steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:0}
.fl-steps li{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;color:var(--ink-2)}
.fl-steps li .dot{position:relative;flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--line-strong);background:var(--paper);z-index:1}
.fl-steps li:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:8px;top:30px;bottom:-10px;width:2px;background:var(--line)}
.fl-steps li.done .dot{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand)}
.fl-steps li.done:not(:last-child)::after{background:var(--brand)}
.fl-steps li[aria-current]{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.fl-steps li[aria-current] .dot{border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 18%,transparent)}
.fl-steps[data-status=delivered] li[aria-current] .dot{background:var(--brand)}
.fl-track .seen{margin:0}
.fl-order{margin:0;display:grid;gap:12px;padding:16px 18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-media,6px)}
.fl-order dt{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-2)}
.fl-order dt:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-size:.85rem}
.fl-order dd{margin:2px 0 0}.fl-order dd span{font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.fl-pin span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--brand);border:2px solid var(--brand);font-size:16px;line-height:1;box-shadow:0 4px 12px -4px rgb(0 0 0/.4)}
.fl-pin.home span{background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand)}
.courier-pin{animation:fl-pulse 1.8s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes fl-pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 55%,transparent),0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0/.35)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px transparent,0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0/.35)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.courier-pin{animation:none}.fl-card{transition:none}}
@media print{.fl-samples,.fl-how,.fl-meter,#sim{display:none}}
html[data-font=boutique] .site-foot strong{color:inherit}html[data-font=boutique] .site-foot p{color:inherit;opacity:.85}
</style>
